process executions, anomalous events and more, and include advanced machine
learning algorithms to detect anomalous behavior.
The following are some of the insights shown:
Screenshot taken on the host.
Processes unsigned by Microsoft detected.
Windows process execution info.
Windows sign-in activity.
Actions on accounts.
Event logs cleared on host.
Group additions.
Enumeration of hosts, users, groups on host.
Microsoft Defender Application Control.
Process rarity via entropy calculation.
Anomalously high number of a security event.
Watchlist insights (Preview).
Windows Defender Antivirus events.
The insights are based on the following data sources:
Syslog (Linux)
SecurityEvent (Windows)
AuditLogs (Microsoft Entra ID)
SigninLogs (Microsoft Entra ID)
OfficeActivity (Office 365)
BehaviorAnalytics (Microsoft Sentinel UEBA)
Heartbeat (Azure Monitor Agent)
CommonSecurityLog (Microsoft Sentinel)
If you want to further explore any of the insights in this panel, select the link
accompanying the insight. The link takes you to the Advanced hunting page, where it
displays the query underlying the insight, along with its raw results. You can modify the
query or drill down into the results to expand your investigation or just satisfy your
curiosity.
